title: Verify reverse-video GtkEntry selection in the preview and complete GTK2 runtime adapter

reference.native_evidence: R113: an idle VUE File Finder field with pattern a*a shows one stable inverse-video character; 124-pixel delta in an 8x16-pixel box, with a separate blinking caret.

method.display: private Xvfb, closed after each probe
method.selection: The field contains a*a; select only the middle asterisk with Shift+Left. The text cursor blink is disabled only in the isolated probe.
method.runtime_adapter: prepare_domainos() produced a complete immutable GTK2 RC and pixmap bundle from each tested KDE palette; no user theme or open application was modified.

implementation.rule: Only GtkEntry selected background/text invert the current KDE View and View Text roles. Generic list/menu selection keeps the KDE Selection roles. Palette refresh generates a new namespaced RC from the active roles; the product contains no fixed final RGB for this selection.

tests.runtime_palette_mapping: passed: focused DomainOS GtkEntry inversion and generic selection regression
tests.domainos_gtk2_preparation: passed: immutable preparation across three schemes
tests.mapped_theme_lab_preview: passed in DomainOS, Breeze Light and Breeze Dark
tests.mapped_complete_runtime_rc: passed in DomainOS, Breeze Light and Breeze Dark; selection bounds [1,2], 234–235 changed pixels per mapped window
tests.python_syntax: passed for all six changed files

limits: The tests establish role-based inverse video in the GTK2 preview and generated runtime RC. They do not prove exact 8x16 text metrics or font parity with VUE.
The native VUE screenshot proves the visible selection state, not which compiled Motif resource supplied its colors.
Xvfb has no window manager. KWin integration, a live schema-change event in the user's session, GTK application reload, and human approval remain untested.
No change has been installed into the user's profile or open XChat session.
next: Continue only I167/GTK2: finish the remaining native line metrics and integration/reload checks using the authorized DomainOS reference, then stage the complete GTK2 adapter for user-session validation.
